name: agent-monitor
description: Classifies every tmux pane running an AI coding agent as working/waiting/done and shows it as a status dot on that window's own PROJECTS-pane row. Zero-config detection from pane titles and Claude Code transcripts; an optional Claude Code hooks snippet upgrades permission-prompt detection.

agentMonitor.programs.description: Comma-separated foreground commands (tmux's pane_current_command) to treat as agents, e.g. "claude,codex".

agentMonitor.waitingThresholdSeconds.description: How long an agent's transcript can go unwritten before it's shown as waiting rather than working. Only used when no hook event is fresher (see the extension's README): a single tool call routinely runs longer than a few seconds without writing anything, so a short threshold reports a busy agent as waiting. Install the hooks snippet for the exact answer instead of a timeout.
